title: Tu Chaliyaan shaam
body:
Tu Chaliyaan shaam
(Haye
shaam) x6
(Tur
<<MINI>>
chaliyan shaamnu baba mein veer kohaake) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
(Mein marke
<<MINI>>
bhee nahi bhulna) x2 gai veer kuna dafna ke hai
Mein veer kohaake
(Tur chaliyan shaamnu baba mein veer kohaake) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Tati raithte
son gaya akbar naale tur gaya gaazi
Peya pathra haith hai baba medda veer namazi
(Aa zainab kon sawaar kara) x2
Vich karbal baba aake hai
<<MINI>>
Mein veer kohaake
(Tur chaliyan shaamnu baba mein veer kohaake) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Shalana koi
mere vango injh laash te aawe
Na behn kise virandi injh uthke jaawe
(Uthi veer di lash to rohndi mein) x2
Jiwe wal wal jidhka khake hai
<<MINI>>
Mein veer kohaake
(Tur chaliyan shaamnu baba mein veer kohaake) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Nai lash te
rohwan dende pay zaalim menu
Iyo jee karda ay mera dhi ankhhe tenu
(Rajh rowa chaar diwaari me) x2
Tadde gal wich bawa pake hai
<<MINI>>
Mein veer kohaake
(Tur chaliyan shaamnu baba mein veer kohaake) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Aa vekh zara
farwa da jo baba haal ay
Nai umbri to pay lubde huth mehndiya waale
(Aa hath lab bhan re qasim de) x2
Mede naal to maqtal jaake hai
<<MINI>>
Mein veer kohaake
(Tur chaliyan shaamnu baba mein veer kohaake) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Payo aap
banada parde to babul mere
Sang poor de wanjhde zainab wich sher de tere
(Teri raah vekha sang parjaaya) x2
Hathqadiya rassiya paake hai
<<MINI>>
Mein veer kohaake
(Tur chaliyan shaamnu baba mein veer kohaake) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Oda matam
jagte resi ta hashr te jaari
Jidi laash te na rajh rooi ek darda mari
(Khursid bacha gya deen jidra) x2
Wich sajde sees katake hai
